tagline: 爱克发取景器相机，1976 年发布
description: 爱克发于1976年推出的取景器相机。

specs.英文简介: The 1035 was one of Agfa's Optima Sensor Electronic series, and featured a self-timer (lever below the view finder), zone focusing information visible in the viewfinder, a top shutter speed of 1/1000th sec., and a multi-coated 40 mm f/2.8 Agfa Solitar lens (4 elements, 3 groups).
